jobs.description_text: 클로버추얼패션 (CLO Virtual Fashion)은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘을 기반으로, 컨셉부터 디자인, 제조, 마케팅, 피팅, 스타일링까지 의상과 관련된 모든 서비스를 제공합니다. 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny 와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여함으로써, 효율적이고 지속 가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 14개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. 전 세계 유저들의 요구 사항을 분석하여 새로운 기능을 만들고 최첨단 의상 시뮬레이션 기술을 연구해 나갈 패기 넘치는 CLOver*를 모집해요! *CLOver는 전세계 CLO Virtual Fashion 구성원을 뜻하는 호칭이에요 :) 특히 컴퓨터 그래픽스/비전 관련 학위와 일정 수준의 C/C++ 기술을 보유한 여러분의 지원을 기다립니다. jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The role covers market analysis, technical vendor evaluation, pricing, modeling, sizing, and design recommendations for our storage (DC-coupled with PV solar and standalone storage) project pipeline. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline. The Director will be responsible for technical analysis of all solar- plus-storage (DC-coupled) and standalone energy storage market opportunities, including optimal system sizing. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. The role also works regularly with project development leads and cross-team leads in Project Development Origination, Grid Interconnection, Engineering, Finance, Delivery, O&M, and Asset Management.The Director will have the opportunity to identify and vet potential areas of new energy storage business development, such as new geographies, programs, incentives, or procurements. This is an opportunity to join a small team in a fast-growing market at an exciting and expanding company. This position offers significant growth potential at a B Corporation with operations across the USA. COM

jobs.title: Data Scientist  - Business Analytics
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries. In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features focused on payments and payments fraud. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business. Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
jobs.description_text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business. The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - TV & Desktop
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer. As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities. As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Free and Premium Conversion
jobs.description_text: Hundreds of millions of people come to Spotify to listen for free. Our ambition is to make that experience great while helping listeners discover the value of Premium. Getting that balance right is one of the most important opportunities for Spotify's continued growth. The Freemium Funnel team shapes the journey from Free listening to Premium subscription and beyond. We bring together Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Research, and Marketing to understand what listeners value, remove barriers to conversion, and create experiences that make Premium a compelling choice. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Free and Conversion Surfaces team. You'll shape how listeners engage with Spotify Free, discover Premium, make the decision to subscribe, and experience their first moments as paying subscribers. From Premium education to conversion experiences and early retention, you'll work on meaningful product challenges that directly influence Spotify's growth. This is an opportunity to think strategically, build at scale, and turn complex challenges into simple, engaging experiences that work for both our listeners and our business.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Spotify Connect
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays. You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager — Subscriptions (Freemium)

We focus on helping listeners discover, experience, and unlock the full value of Spotify through awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. You'll lead product initiatives that make Premium more compelling, improve the journey from Free to Paid, and create experiences that reflect the needs of local audiences. jobs.title: Index Analyst Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: About Syntax Data Syntax LLC is a financial data and technology company that codifies business models into a relational system we call Affinity Data™. Syntax operates through three segments: Affinity Data™, Syntax Direct™, and Syntax Indices™. jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads is building the largest mobility media network. Brands use Lyft Ads to reach riders throughout their journeys, in the Lyft app, in the real world, and across the open web. Every time a rider opens the app, our systems decide in milliseconds which message they see, whether it’s a paid ad, an incentive, or a product message from another Lyft team.

The Ad Decisioning team owns that choice. We run the serving, pacing, and auction systems behind every ad on Lyft surfaces, and we are building a first-party decisioning platform that lets paid and unpaid messages compete in a single auction based on their value to riders, advertisers, and Lyft. This platform is shared infrastructure. Ads and other teams will all use it to reach riders and drivers across multiple apps and surfaces. The work spans real-time distributed systems, auction design, and close partnership with teams across Lyft that message riders and drivers.

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead this team. The future of Lyft is a hybrid network, where autonomous vehicles and human drivers serve riders side by side on one platform. That future has already started. In September 2026, Lyft riders in Nashville were matched with Waymo autonomous vehicles on the Lyft app for the first time, a milestone years in the making. Through Flexdrive, Lyft manages the depots, charging and maintenance that keep autonomous fleets on the road. Our partnerships now span Waymo in Nashville, May Mobility in Atlanta and Baidu in Europe, with more on the way.

We are early, and the playbook for running a hybrid marketplace at scale hasn't been written yet. You will help write it.

The Global Growth organization is charting the future of Lyft's growth beyond North American rideshare's core products. This includes our premium Luxury modes and Livery drivers, building a unified Lyft presence internationally, and bringing Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) to riders domestically and abroad. As the Senior Data Scientist for AV, you will be a key science partner on one of the most strategic bets at the company. For us, maps aren't just background graphics—they’re the core of the driver’s experience. While generic navigation apps focus on the everyday commute, Lyft Mapping is custom-built for the high-stakes, split-second realities of the rideshare experience. Drivers choose Lyft Maps because we solve the unique, complex challenges of living on the road: delivering glanceable turn guidance at speed, navigating tricky pick-up & drop-off dynamics, and providing real-time, AI-powered route assistance when every second counts. We build technology that empowers our drivers, transforms uncertainty into seamless flow, and sets the standard for real-time mobile navigation.

We obsess over questions like: did your pickup spot feel safe and convenient? Did your driver feel confident following the route and arriving on the correct side of the road? Did you get stuck in unexpected traffic or road closures? You will tackle all of these challenges and more, with end to end ownership over the full ride experience, including driver navigation and rider pickup experiences.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

jobs.description_text: Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Achter het platform zit een groeiende stroom leerdata. Die moet klanten, de business en de AI-features die we bouwen écht verder helpen. Daar zoeken we een Data Engineer voor die de datalaag bezit. De rol Je komt in een klein datateam binnen Product & Tech en rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering. Je werk bedient twee takken. Business: rapportages voor commerce, management en investeerders. Product: de inzichten die klanten in het platform zien, zoals voortgang en budget. Collega’s bouwen de dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt en meebeweegt met het product. Je werkt dagelijks samen met een businessanalist en een productanalist, die ook met Looker en dbt werkt. Er komt nog een analist bij. Een ervaren data engineer sluit één dag per week aan en een Data Lead staat op de planning. Wat je doet Je bent eigenaar van het Snowflake-platform: rollen en rechten, warehouse sizing en provisioning, tasks en kosten. Je beheert GitHub voor het dataplatform: branches, environments en automatisering met GitHub Actions. Je neemt Databricks, opgezet voor een high-security omgeving, over van een externe partij en bereidt de migratie van Snowflake naar Databricks voor, gepland voor volgend jaar. Je bouwt pipelines die incrementeel, idempotent, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn, en ontsluit bronnen via Fivetran of custom connectors.
